method: deterministic diagnostic through actual OFL edge; scripted model and synthetic sources
scope: architecture constraints and preserved safeguards, not market demand or live-model quality

cases.criterion: Preserve a relevant clarification instead of replacing every no-tool response with generic required fields
cases.observation: A relevant scripted explanation is replaced by the fixed market-field request.

cases.job: Scope an investigation without knowing database codes
cases.criterion: Retain the user's goal-oriented clarification before requiring a three-digit market code
cases.observation: The planner discards the tailored scoping question.

cases.job: Search, inspect context, then produce an evidence-backed result
cases.criterion: Allow a dependent second read using the item ID found by the first read
cases.observation: The one-planning-step policy ends the turn before the dependent read.

cases.job: Combine OFL macro data, fund letters and news for a research brief
cases.criterion: Provide a route from specialist tools to all three existing upstream asset classes
cases.observation: Current catalogs cannot access the macro snapshot or the separately stored letters/news.

cases.job: Inspect precise, qualified source data without model-invented figures
cases.criterion: Preserve exact source price, release and basis while suppressing invented planner prose
cases.observation: Source values and provenance survive the turn; invented planning prose is not displayed.

cases.job: Inspect research without accidental publication or data mutation
cases.observation: All currently offered specialist tools are read-only.
